S.FORM: bniru:Sabi Nobu smi squ sabu qba, gitan qrapit, mqas balay kwara squ seto mcqbaq son nanu kbalay qrapit, maki squ pincbaqan ni sinsi. baqun nha qrapit qani ga pinbahuw na cinqalang, sinnlwan nha mha spwah squ knalay na seto nanak ru baqun nha puqing galan na nniqun. musa nha baqun nanu cbaq zywaw na puqing kyo'ik nqu nniqun pinbahuw, Sin'igo ga u'buy squ pinbahuw qu piyang balay qqnxan, yan na pinbahuw ga piyang balay ga ume qu galan nha, nasun nha kwara squ zenko galan nha ume. aki baqun nqu seto ga aring cipuq cinqalang nha nanak. nanu Sin'i nqu pqwasan biru laqi cikuy qani ga tpihan nqu aring squ Sin'igo na nokay mwah squ pqwasan biru laqi cikuy. mwah tcqbaq cyo_ik nqu pinbahuw, ahi baqun nqu lelaqi son nanu mlahang ru cukaw rhiyal, ru musa klabang kinlokah squ sinrxan nanak. zywaw nqu cyo'ik pinbahuw qani ga, llgan naha ru pngsa squ bunka na Bunun zok, ahi naha baqun squ seto sinrxan nha nanak, musa sgsu ru sinlokah mha aki musa lemuruw sinhluyan na qalang naha, ru lemaras squ zywaw nqu kinlokah ru lemeliq nqu kezay na qalang naha.
S.PHON: βniru[s|ɕ]aβi noβu [s|ɕ]mi [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]aβu qβa ɣitan qrapit mqa[s|ɕ] βalaj kwara [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]eto m[ʦ|ʨ]qβaq [s|ɕ]on nanu kβalaj qrapit maki [s|ɕ]qu pin[ʦ|ʨ]βaqan ni [s|ɕ]in[s|ɕ]i βaqun nħa qrapit qani ɣa pinβaħuw na [ʦ|ʨ]inqalaŋ [s|ɕ]innlwan nħa mħa [s|ɕ]pwaħ [s|ɕ]qu knalaj na [s|ɕ]eto nanak ru βaqun nħa puqiŋ ɣalan na nniqun mu[s|ɕ]a nħa βaqun nanu [ʦ|ʨ]βaq zjwaw na puqiŋ kjoʔik nqu nniqun pinβaħuw [s|ɕ]inʔiɣo ɣa uʔβuj [s|ɕ]qu pinβaħuw qu pijaŋ βalaj qqnxan jan na pinβaħuw ɣa pijaŋ βalaj ɣa ume qu ɣalan nħa na[s|ɕ]un nħa kwara [s|ɕ]qu zenko ɣalan nħa ume aki βaqun nqu [s|ɕ]eto ɣa ariŋ [ʦ|ʨ]ipuq [ʦ|ʨ]inqalaŋ nħa nanak nanu [s|ɕ]inʔi nqu pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru laqi [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj qani ɣa tpiħan nqu ariŋ [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]inʔiɣo na nokaj mwaħ [s|ɕ]qu pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru laqi [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj mwaħ t[ʦ|ʨ]qβaq [ʦ|ʨ]joəik nqu pinβaħuw aħi βaqun nqu lelaqi [s|ɕ]on nanu mlaħaŋ ru [ʦ|ʨ]ukaw rħijal ru mu[s|ɕ]a klaβaŋ kinlokaħ [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]inrxan nanak zjwaw nqu [ʦ|ʨ]joʔik pinβaħuw qani ɣa llɣan naħa ru pŋ[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]qu βunka na βunun zok aħi naħa βaqun [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]eto [s|ɕ]inrxan nħa nanak mu[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ɣ[s|ɕ]u ru [s|ɕ]inlokaħ mħa aki mu[s|ɕ]a lemuruw [s|ɕ]inħlujan na qalaŋ naħa ru lemara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu zjwaw nqu kinlokaħ ru lemeliq nqu kezaj na qalaŋ naħa
